# Finding ledger

Historical snapshot: see [2026-10-20 current dispositions](current-findings.md) for refreshed counts
and all retained IDs.

Baseline: 2026-10-19, application `87c15e1e5d89344db7dcaaa85ebb1f6972c0c829`.

The default CLI groups 2,177 individual failures into 2,119 displayed lines and omits one warning.
This ledger retains **all 2,178 non-OK reports**, including every grouped model/connection and the
warning. After C7 compatibility reversion: **2,123 individual failures, 2,065 displayed groups and
one warning** remain.

Stable IDs use the first 12 SHA-256 hex digits of `connection|table|model|attribute|checker`. IDs
survive wording/count/order changes. Keep resolved rows; append new identities. `H-` families are
investigation hypotheses, not proven root causes. `R-` groups have code/schema grounds but still
require verified closure. The index/association detail includes predicates, scopes, FK target and
checker metadata where present. `Original report` uses CLI text when individually displayed, and the
raw error slug/message for reports hidden in a CLI group. No report is suppressed.
